messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

const long long mod1 = 998244353, mod2 = 1e9 + 7;

long long dfn, n, nLow, nAns;
long long pw[8];
vector<int> num[7];

void dfs1(int dig, int x) {
	int tmp = (dfn + mod1 - x) % mod1;
	num[dig].push_back(tmp);
	nLow = (nLow + tmp) % mod2;
	dfn++;
	if (dig < 6) {
		int i;
		for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) dfs1(dig + 1, x * 10 + i);
	}
}

void dfs2(int dig, long long x) {
	if (x > n) return;
	int i;
	if (x * pw[6] + pw[6] - 1 <= n && x * pw[7] > n) {
		for (i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
			long long delt = (dfn + (mod1 - pw[i]) * x) % mod1;
			nAns = (nAns + (delt + mod2 - mod1) * pw[i] + mod1 * (lower_bound(num[i].begin(), num[i].end(), mod1 - delt) - num[i].begin())) % mod2;
		}
		nAns = (nAns + nLow) % mod2;
		dfn += 1111111;
		return;
	}
	nAns = (nAns + (dfn + mod1 - x % mod1)) % mod2;
	dfn++;
	for (i = dig ? 0 : 1; i < 10; i++) dfs2(dig + 1, x * 10 + i);
}

int main() {
	int i;
	pw[0] = 1;
	for (i = 1; i <= 7; i++) pw[i] = pw[i - 1] * 10;
	dfs1(0, 0);
	for (i = 1; i <= 6; i++) sort(num[i].begin(), num[i].end());
	cin >> n;
	dfn = 0;
	dfs2(0, 0);
	cout << nAns << endl;
	return 0;
}
